body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Haier Korea presented ''L46A18-A'' 46-inch LCD TV equipped with PVR, which can record broadcasting programs for a certain amount of time without the need for VCR.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
